title: Modularity of elliptic curves over totally real fields
summary: Every elliptic curve over every totally real number field is modular with all local factors. The cyclic covers, integral regular-module lattices, character systems and congruences of EllipticCurveModularityImaginaryQuadratic are twisted by the reflection to totally odd rank-two systems over the real cyclotomic subfield L = K(zeta_3p + zeta_3p^-1); the totally real weight-two lifting theorem, started from the Freitas-Le Hung-Siksek mod-five seed on an auxiliary elliptic curve, propagates modularity along W_eta =_p W_chi =_3 W_psi =_p W_1; soluble descent along L/K, removal of two quadratic twists, the Hilbert local-global compatibility and a CM induction branch give the endpoint.

layers.title: Reflection descent over the real cyclotomic subfield

targets.name: realCyclotomicData
targets.statement: For a number field k and n >= 3, with zeta a primitive n-th root of unity, set M = k(mu_n), L = k(zeta + zeta^-1) and delta : G_L -> {+-1} with g(zeta) = zeta^delta(g). Then L is independent of zeta; M = L(zeta), [M:L] <= 2, every g in G_L acts on mu_n by x -> x^delta(g) and delta is the character of M/L; M/k and L/k are abelian; if k is totally real then L is totally real, [M:L] = 2, M is CM with L its maximal real subfield, and delta(c) = -1 for every complex conjugation c in G_L; if k is totally real and l is an odd prime dividing n then L(mu_l) = M.
hypotheses: total reality of k only for the last two clauses

api.name: independent of zeta
api.statement: zeta^a + zeta^-a is an integer polynomial in zeta + zeta^-1 for a prime to n, so L does not depend on zeta

api.name: delta on G_M
api.statement: delta is trivial on G_M and factors through Gal(M/L)

api.name: base change
api.statement: for finite k'/k the data of (k',n) are k'L, k'M and the restriction of delta

api.name: divisors
api.statement: for d >= 3 dividing n the data (M_d, L_d, delta_d) of (k,d) satisfy M_d in M, L_d in L and delta_d restricted to G_L equals delta (zeta_d = zeta^(n/d)); for d in {1,2} the data are k with trivial character, which differs from delta when delta is nontrivial

api.name: Mathlib comparison
api.statement: for k totally real L equals NumberField.maximalRealSubfield M and M is NumberField.IsCMField

tests.name: rational n=3
tests.statement: k = Q, n = 3: zeta_3 + zeta_3^-1 = -1, so L = Q, M = Q(sqrt -3), delta(Frob_7) = 1, delta(Frob_2) = -1; defining L as k(zeta) would give L = M

tests.name: cubic and quartic
tests.statement: k = Q, n = 9: 2cos(2pi/9) is a root of x^3 - 3x + 1, L cubic; n = 15: [L:Q] = 4 and sqrt 5 lies in L

tests.name: degenerate
tests.statement: k = Q(sqrt -3), n = 3: M = L = k and delta trivial; n = 1, 2 give L = M = k

tests.name: not maximal real subfield
tests.statement: k = Q(i), n = 3: L = Q(i) while the maximal real subfield of M = Q(zeta_12) is Q(sqrt 3), which does not contain k

tests.name: Mathlib agreement
tests.statement: for k = Q and n = 5, L = Q(sqrt 5) is NumberField.maximalRealSubfield of Q(zeta_5), a CM field by IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isCMField

tests.name: divisor boundary
tests.statement: k = Q, n = 3, d = 1: the trivial character is 1 at complex conjugation while delta is -1, so the divisor statement needs d >= 3

targets.name: reflectionTwist
targets.statement: For a number field k, E: y^2 = h(x), odd n >= 3, t in U(k) and m | n with m > 1, the twist C^delta_m of C_m(t) tensor L by the cocycle g -> w^e(g) (delta = (-1)^e): a smooth proper geometrically connected genus-m curve over L with phi : C^delta_m tensor M -> C_m tensor M, phi o g(phi)^-1 = w^e(g). The transported rotations and reflection are L-rational with the same relations; quotient maps twist; C^delta_m/<u'> = B_t^delta, and if 3 | n then C^delta_3/<w'> = D_t tensor L; phi^* identifies integral H^1 with the action (w^*)^e(g) rho(g). For m = 1, C^delta_1 = B_t^delta.
hypotheses: 3 | n for the cubic quotient C^delta_3/<w'>

locator.where: Section 3.2, (9) and Lemma 3.2 with proof, p.6 (LeHung26 lines 237-240, 245)

api.name: trivial twist
api.statement: if delta is trivial the twist is C_m tensor L with phi the identity

api.name: base change
api.statement: formation commutes with finite L'/L, transporting phi

api.name: tower
api.statement: twisted quotient maps compose for d | m | n

api.name: Jacobian
api.statement: Pic^0(C^delta_m) is an abelian variety over L with L-endomorphisms u' and w'

api.name: restriction to M
api.statement: C^delta_m tensor M is C_m tensor M through phi, compatibly with rotations, reflection and quotients

tests.name: matrix descent witness
tests.statement: for delta nontrivial and g in G_L with delta(g) = -1: R = [[0,-1],[1,-1]], W = [[0,1],[1,0]]: WRW = [[-1,1],[-1,0]] = R^-1 and W R^-1 W = R, while R^-1 != R

tests.name: trivial character
tests.statement: k = Q(sqrt -3), n = 3: delta trivial, the rotations are already L-rational and the twist is C_3 tensor L

tests.name: rotation cocycle fails
tests.statement: for delta nontrivial, a rotation-valued cocycle leaves u_(zeta^-1) unchanged under conjugation, so rotations stay non-rational; for delta trivial L = M contains k(mu_m) and nothing needs repair

tests.name: quadratic twist sign
tests.statement: y^2 = x^3 - x + 1 over F_5 has 8 points (a_5 = -2); its twist by the nonsquare 2 has 4 points (a_5 = 2)

tests.name: cubic clause needs 3 | n
tests.statement: n = 5: the tower has indices 1 and 5; forcing Y^3 = f_t gives valuations 1, -1, -5, 5 at S, -S, R, -R, four branch points, 2g - 2 = 8 and genus 5; for n = 15 the valuations -15, 15 at R, -R are divisible by 3, two branch points and genus 3

targets.name: descendedCharacterSystem
targets.statement: For theta : mu_n -> M_0^x and a prime l, W_(theta,l) is the theta-eigenspace of the L-rational rotations on H^1(C^delta_n over Lbar, Qbar_l), with u'^* x = j_l(theta(zeta)) x; it is G_L-stable. Only the eigenspaces, their Galois actions and the idempotents are constructed here; the compatible system is assembled at the end of 1.4.
hypotheses: fixed embeddings j, j_l of M_0

api.name: restriction to G_M
api.statement: phi^* restricts to a G_M-isomorphism V_theta -> W_theta

api.name: reflection
api.statement: w'^* maps W_theta onto W_(theta^-1) G_L-equivariantly

api.name: idempotent
api.statement: W_theta is the image of e_theta = n^-1 sum theta(zeta)^-1 u'^*_zeta in End_L(J^delta_n) tensor M_0

api.name: quotient
api.statement: for d | n and theta of order dividing d, pullback from C^delta_d identifies its theta-part with W_theta rationally

api.name: coefficients
api.statement: coefficient extension and change of j_l transport the eigenspace with the fixed label

tests.name: dimension six
tests.statement: n = 3: H^1(C^delta_3) has dimension 6 = 2 + 2 + 2 over W_1, W_eta, W_(eta^-1)

tests.name: trivial character
tests.statement: theta = 1 gives W_1 = H^1(B_t^delta), of rank two

tests.name: induction
tests.statement: Ind from G_M to G_L of V_theta is W_theta + W_theta tensor delta, of rank 2[M:L]: four when delta is nontrivial (every totally real k), two for k = Q(sqrt -3), n = 3, where M = L

tests.name: l divides n
tests.statement: for l | n the eigenspace is taken rationally; the integral statement is 1.5 without an integral projector

targets.name: descended_system_properties
targets.statement: Let S be the places of L of bad reduction of J^delta_n and those above n. Each W_(theta,l) is semisimple of dimension two with determinant eps_l^-1, potentially semistable at every v | l with labelled Hodge-Tate weights {0,1} and crystalline at v | l outside S; outside S and away from l it is unramified with Frobenius polynomial j_l(P_(theta,v)) for a monic degree-two P_(theta,v) in M_0[X] independent of l with constant term q_v; if k is totally real it is totally odd. Then the descended system is assembled on the shared raw carrier over L (coefficient field M_0, bad set S, polynomials P_(theta,v), members W_(theta,l) realized over the completions of M_0, Hodge multisets {0,1}) and satisfies the weak predicate of AG2.P.
hypotheses: k totally real for total oddness

locator.where: Lemma 3.2 and proof, p.6 (LeHung26 lines 241-242, 247-248); OpenAI26 Proposition 5.1, pp.12-13 (OpenAI26 line 480)

tests.name: cup product degenerate
tests.statement: cup product pairs W_theta with itself to zero when theta^2 != 1; the reflection is needed

tests.name: oddness of W_1
tests.statement: det W_1 = eps^-1 delta^2 = eps^-1, value -1 at complex conjugation

tests.name: non totally real
tests.statement: k = Q(sqrt -3) has no real places and oddness is vacuous

targets.name: descended_congruence_chain
targets.statement: For a finite extension E_lambda of Q_l in Qbar_l containing j_l(M_0), with ring of integers O (which never contains j_l(M_0), as 1/l is in M_0; the values j_l(theta(zeta)) are roots of unity, hence in O^x), T^delta_theta = H^1(C^delta_n over Lbar, Z_l) tensor over Z_l[U'] via j_l o theta of O is O-free of rank two, G_L-stable, with T^delta_theta tensor_O Qbar_l = W_(theta,l); if j_l o theta and j_l o theta' have equal reductions mod m, the residual G_L-modules are isomorphic, including l | n. For n = 3p, p > 3 prime: W_eta =_p W_chi =_3 W_psi =_p W_1 over L, and W_eta =_3 W_1.
hypotheses: E_lambda a finite extension of Q_l in Qbar_l containing j_l(M_0), O its ring of integers
n = 3p, p > 3 prime for the chain

locator.where: Lemma 3.2, (10) and proof, p.6 (LeHung26 lines 243, 246-247); OpenAI26 Lemma 5.3, p.13 (line 547) and Corollary 5.4, p.14 (line 571)

api.name: evaluation
api.statement: T^delta_theta is the quotient of H^1 tensor_(Z_l) O by the O-span of (u'^*_zeta - j_l(theta(zeta)))x; the quotient map is O-linear, G_L-equivariant and intertwines u'^*_zeta with multiplication by j_l(theta(zeta))

api.name: rank two
api.statement: for every l, including l | n, T^delta_theta is O-free of rank two, from the regular-module marking of ECMIQ §3.1 transported by 1.2(5)

api.name: Galois action
api.statement: G_L acts continuously and O-linearly, commuting with U', since the rotations are L-rational

api.name: rationalization
api.statement: T^delta_theta tensor_O E_lambda is the theta-eigenspace of H^1 with E_lambda coefficients, and its extension to Qbar_l is W_(theta,l)

api.name: coefficient extension
api.statement: for finite E'/E_lambda with integers O', the lattice formed with O' is T^delta_theta tensor_O O', G_L-equivariantly

api.name: restriction to G_M
api.statement: phi^* identifies T^delta_theta restricted to G_M with ECMIQ §4.3 characterLattice theta at t over F = M

api.name: reduction
api.statement: T^delta_theta / m = H^1(C^delta_n, F_l) tensor over F_l[U'] via theta-bar of kappa depends only on theta-bar = j_l o theta mod m; its semisimplification is the semisimplified reduction of W_(theta,l)

tests.name: coefficient ring
tests.statement: 1/l in M_0 has v_l = -1, so no ring of integers contains j_l(M_0); for l = 3, n = 3p, E_lambda = Q_3(mu_n) contains j_3(M_0), the theta-values are units and T^delta_theta is free of rank two while 1/3 is not in O

tests.name: l = 3 divides n
tests.statement: Z_3[mu_3p] is not semisimple mod 3; freeness holds without dividing by 3

tests.name: mod 3 endpoint congruence
tests.statement: eta reduces to 1 mod 3 so W_eta =_3 W_1: H^1(A_t) is congruent mod 3 to a quadratic twist of E (LeHung26 lines 136-138)

tests.name: reversed primes
tests.statement: mod 3, chi-bar = psi-bar != 1 = eta-bar, so W_chi =_3 W_psi and not W_eta

tests.name: untwisted lattice
tests.statement: for delta nontrivial and theta != 1 (so theta != theta^-1, n odd), g in G_L with delta(g) = -1 carries the kernel of the theta-evaluation of the untwisted H^1(C_n) tensor O to that of the theta^-1-evaluation, so G_L does not act on the untwisted quotient; positive control: theta = 1, where both labels are 1 and the untwisted coinvariant quotient is G_L-stable, and every evaluation is stable when delta is trivial

targets.name: descended_elliptic_endpoints
targets.statement: If 3 | n, then for every order-three eta and every l, W_eta is isomorphic to H^1(A_t) restricted to G_L, A_t = Pic^0(D_t); for every odd n >= 3, W_1 is isomorphic to H^1(B_t)|G_L tensor delta; hence H^1(E)|G_L = W_1 tensor delta tensor chi_h(t). The isomorphisms are rational and compatible with coefficient embeddings.

locator.where: Lemma 3.2, (11) and proof, p.6 (LeHung26 lines 244, 248-249); OpenAI26 Proposition 5.2, p.13 (line 521)

tests.name: invariant dimension
tests.statement: H^1(C^delta_3)^(w') has dimension 2: 0 from W_1 (w' = -1) and 2 from the 4-dimensional W_eta + W_(eta^-1)

tests.name: delta matters
tests.statement: at a place inert in M/L the traces of W_1 and H^1(B_t) differ by sign

tests.name: rational only
tests.statement: pullback along C^delta_n -> C^delta_d then norm is multiplication by n/d (by n along C^delta_n -> B^delta_t): 15 for n = 45, d = 3; p for n = 3p, d = 3; 3 for n = 3p, d = p; congruences use semisimplification

layers.title: Totally real lifting and the elliptic seed

targets.name: compatible_change_of_prime
targets.statement: For F totally real and a weakly compatible rank-two system R on the shared carrier with semisimple members: if R_(l0) is isomorphic to rho_(pi,iota0) for a cuspidal pi of type (2,0) with iota0 o j_(l0) = j, then R_l is isomorphic to rho_(pi,iota) for every l and every iota with iota o j_l = j.

tests.name: semisimplicity needed
tests.statement: a nonsplit extension of eps^-1 by 1 and 1 + eps^-1 have equal Frobenius polynomials and are not isomorphic

tests.name: 11a1
tests.statement: X^2 + X + 3 at 3 for every l != 3, matching t_3 = -1, s_3 = 1

tests.name: labels
tests.statement: replacing psi by psi^2 at one prime breaks compatibility; psi^-1 is harmless since W_psi = W_(psi^-1)

targets.name: summand_weight_two_lifting
targets.statement: L totally real, l odd, A/L abelian variety, e idempotent of End_L(A) tensor Qbar, r = e H^1(A over Lbar, Qbar_l) of dimension two with det r = eps_l^-1 and labelled weights {0,1}. If r-bar is residually modular and absolutely irreducible on G_(L(zeta_l)), and when l = 5 either the image of r-bar(G_(L(zeta_5))) in PGL2(Fbar_5) is not isomorphic to PSL2(F5) or r-bar is the scalar extension of a representation G_L -> GL2(F5), then r is modular; no local condition is imposed. For A = E elliptic and e = 1 the residual representation is the dual of E[l], an F_l-model, so the second alternative holds at l = 5.
hypotheses: if l = 5: projective image of r-bar(G_(L(zeta_5))) not PSL2(F5), or r-bar has an F5-model

locator.where: Proposition 3.1, p.6 (LeHung26 line 231; excludes l = 5); FLHS15 Theorem 2, p.3 (line 116) and Section 2, pp.5-6 (lines 221-265, the F5-model argument at five); BD14 Theoreme 3.2.2, pp.36-37 (lines 2144-2146)

tests.name: l = 2
tests.statement: excluded: the residual determinant is 1 at complex conjugation

tests.name: mixed local types
tests.statement: multiplicative, ordinary and supersingular places above l may coexist, unlike GL2ModularityLifting §5.7

tests.name: F5-model at five
tests.statement: for r-bar = r0 tensor Fbar_5 with det r0 = eps-bar_5^-1 the projective square class is det r0 mod squares, the character of L(sqrt 5)/L; Gal(K0/L) = PSL2(F5) = A5 with zeta_5 in K0 would force sqrt 5 in L and an order-two quotient Gal(L(zeta_5)/L) of the simple group A5 of order 60

tests.name: weight one
tests.statement: an Artin representation with weights {0,0} is outside the statement

tests.name: determinant without F5-model
tests.statement: in F_25 with a^2 = 3, B = [[0,2],[1,0]], C = aB: B^2 = 2I, C^2 = I, det C = 4 a square in F5, but [C] = [B] with det B = 3 a nonsquare, so [C] is not in PSL2(F5); the determinant square class alone does not control the projective image

targets.name: five_three_switch_curve
targets.statement: For every number field K and elliptic E/K there is an elliptic E'/K with a G_K-isomorphism E[5] = E'[5] compatible with Weil pairings such that the image of G_K on E'[3] contains SL2(F3); the j-invariants of such E' form an infinite set.

locator.where: Lemma 6.1 and its proof, p.10 (FLHS15 line 421, lines 430-452)

tests.name: group orders
tests.statement: 24 divides none of 12 (Borel), 8, 16 (Cartan normalizers) in GL2(F3): E' is non-CM with irreducible mod-3 representation

tests.name: zeta_3 in K
tests.statement: over Q(sqrt -3) the image is at most SL2(F3); asking for GL2(F3) would be false

tests.name: all frames
tests.statement: the all-frames level-3 cover P has phi(3) = 2 geometric components (one per Weil-pairing value), so is not geometrically integral; if zeta_3 is not in K (K = Q) the arithmetic monodromy GL2(F3) of order 48 exchanges them and P is integral (P_0 = P); if zeta_3 is in K (K = Q(sqrt -3)) P has two K-components of degree 24; Hilbert irreducibility needs integrality over K only

targets.name: totallyReal_mod_three_seed
targets.statement: K totally real, E/K elliptic with E[3] absolutely irreducible on G_(K(zeta_3)): E is modular.

tests.name: cyclotomic subgroup
tests.statement: image of G_(K(zeta_3)) is image of G_K intersected with SL2(F3) (FLHS15 Proposition 4.1)

tests.name: Cartan case
tests.statement: irreducible over K but reducible over K(zeta_3) forces a Cartan normalizer (FLHS15 Lemma 4.2); statement does not apply

targets.name: totallyReal_mod_five_seed
targets.statement: K totally real, E/K elliptic with E[5] absolutely irreducible on G_(K(zeta_5)): E is modular.

locator.where: Theorem 3, p.3 (FLHS15 line 127) and its proof for p = 5, p.10 (lines 426-429)

tests.name: 11a1
tests.statement: 11a1 has a rational 5-torsion point, so its mod-5 representation is reducible and the hypothesis fails

tests.name: stabilizer bound
tests.statement: a line over F3-bar has stabilizer of order 6 or dividing 4 in SL2(F3), less than 24: absolute irreducibility

tests.name: zeta_5 not in K
tests.statement: K totally real so zeta_5 is not in K; the residual representation is the dual of E[5], an F5-model with determinant eps-bar_5^-1, so the F5-model alternative of 2.2 applies; for image GL2(F5) the image of G_(K(zeta_5)) is SL2(F5) with projective image PSL2(F5), so the projective-image alternative fails

layers.title: One specialization and three lifts over L

targets.name: totallyReal_switch_parameter
targets.statement: K totally real of degree d, E/K geometrically non-CM, p > max{100, 2d+1} outside the exceptional set of the large-image theorem over the normal closure, n = 3p. There is t in U(K) with: W-bar_(eta,p) absolutely irreducible on G_(L(zeta_p)) for every order-3 eta; W-bar_(psi,3) absolutely irreducible on G_(L(zeta_3)) for every order-p psi; W-bar_(1,p) absolutely irreducible on G_(L(zeta_p)); A_t[5] absolutely irreducible on G_(L(zeta_5)); A_t geometrically non-CM.
hypotheses: p outside the exceptional set over the normal closure

locator.where: Section 3.3, pp.6-7 (LeHung26 lines 250-260); OpenAI26 Proposition 8.4, p.23 (line 990)

tests.name: c(lambda) at (3,5)
tests.statement: 2 - lambda - lambda^-1 = 3 at a primitive cube root, nonzero mod 5

tests.name: (p,3) field bound
tests.statement: an order-p unit with p > 100 is not in F_(3^a), a <= 4, whose unit groups have order at most 80

tests.name: distinct primes
tests.statement: p > 100 excludes p = 3, 5

targets.name: auxiliary_seed_over_real_cyclotomic
targets.statement: At the parameter of 3.1, A_t tensor L is modular and W_(eta,l) is modular for every order-3 eta and every l.

tests.name: over L
tests.statement: the seed is applied directly over L, avoiding an automorphic base change from K; the residual condition also holds over K, since G_(L(zeta_5)) is contained in G_(K(zeta_5)) and an invariant line for the larger group is invariant for the smaller

tests.name: both cubic characters
tests.statement: W_eta and W_(eta^-1) are both H^1(A_t)|G_L

tests.name: five not in chain
tests.statement: no congruence of 1.5 is at five

targets.name: totallyReal_three_lifts
targets.statement: At the parameter of 3.1, W_chi, W_psi and W_1 are modular over L, by 2.2 applied to A = Pic^0(C^delta_n), e = e_theta, at the primes p, 3, p in turn, changing the coefficient prime by 2.1 after each row.

locator.where: Section 3.4 and its table, p.7 (LeHung26 lines 264-269)

tests.name: middle prime
tests.statement: the middle lift is at 3 after changing the coefficient prime of pi_chi from p to 3

tests.name: no local matching
tests.statement: ordinary, supersingular and multiplicative places above the lifting prime occur in any combination

tests.name: no five
tests.statement: the five-adic clause of 2.2 is unused in the three rows

layers.title: Descent, all places, CM curves and the endpoint

targets.name: nonCM_totallyReal_modularity
targets.statement: For K totally real and E/K geometrically non-CM, E is modular: W_1 modular over L, twist by delta, descend along the abelian extension L/K by soluble descent, and twist by chi_h(t).

tests.name: irreducible restriction
tests.statement: H^1(B_t)|G_L is irreducible because its mod-p reduction is absolutely irreducible on G_M

tests.name: quadratic descent ambiguity
tests.statement: the two descents at a quadratic step differ by the quadratic character; the one matching H^1(B_t) is selected

tests.name: square h(t)
tests.statement: if h(t) is a square in K, chi_h(t) is trivial and B_t = E

targets.name: totallyReal_full_local_comparison
targets.statement: K totally real, E/K elliptic, pi cuspidal of type (2,0) with rho_(pi,iota0) = H^1(E) at one (l0, iota0): pi has trivial central character and is unique; rho_(pi,iota) = H^1(E) for all l, iota; full Frobenius-semisimple WD comparison with monodromy at every finite v not dividing l and at v | l for the potentially semistable WD; every finite Euler factor and the archimedean factors agree; conductor exponents agree, so the newvector has exact level the conductor; t_v = a_v(E) in Z, s_v = 1, field of rationality Q; at multiplicative places N != 0 and pi_v is Steinberg twisted by an unramified character of order <= 2; at additive potentially multiplicative places a ramified quadratic twist of Steinberg; local factor 1 at every additive place.
hypotheses: pi cuspidal of type (2,0) realizing H^1(E) at one prime

locator.where: Section 5, p.9 (LeHung26 lines 361-363); FLHS15 Section 1, p.2 (lines 66-77)

tests.name: 11a1 at 11
tests.statement: a_11 = 1, split multiplicative, Steinberg, conductor exponent 1, factor (1 - 11^-s)^-1

tests.name: multiplicative at 23
tests.statement: y^2 = x^3 - x + 1: Delta = -368 = -2^4 23, c4 = 48 a unit at 23; over Q(sqrt 5) 23 is inert and the reduction is split

tests.name: additive
tests.statement: y^2 = x^3 - x at 2: conductor 32, exponent 5, local factor 1

tests.name: archimedean
tests.statement: D_2 unitary factor Gamma_C(s + 1/2) becomes Gamma_C(s) after s -> s - 1/2

targets.name: totallyReal_cm_modularity
targets.statement: For K totally real and E/K geometrically CM by T, embedded in Kbar through the action on invariant differentials: T is not in K, and with the endomorphism field KT supplied by gap:cm-elliptic-endomorphism-field, H^1(E)|G_KT = psi + psi^c with psi = r_(l,iota)(theta) for an algebraic Hecke character theta of KT, psi != psi^c, H^1(E) = Ind psi, and pi_E = AI_(KT/K)(theta), unitarily normalized, is cuspidal of type (2,0) with trivial central character and rho_(pi_E,iota) = H^1(E).

locator.where: Section 5, p.9 (LeHung26 lines 364-366); OpenAI26 Section 9.4, pp.27-28 (OpenAI26 lines 1200-1215)

tests.name: y^2 = x^3 - x
tests.statement: over Q: 4 points over F_3 (a_3 = 0, inert), 8 points over F_5 (a_5 = -2 = psi + psi-bar, psi = -1 +- 2i)

tests.name: y^2 = x^3 + 1
tests.statement: CM by Q(sqrt -3): 6 points over F_5, a_5 = 0 at the inert prime 5

tests.name: no sum branch
tests.statement: over Q(i), outside scope, y^2 = x^3 - x gives an isobaric sum; over a totally real base induction is always cuspidal

tests.name: field of definition
tests.statement: as supplied by gap:cm-elliptic-endomorphism-field: on y^2 = x^3 - x, [i](x,y) = (-x, iy) pulls dx/2y back to i dx/2y; complex conjugation sends [i] to (x,y) -> (-x,-iy) = [-i], so [i] is defined over Q(i), not Q; the kernel of G_Q on End is G_Q(i), over Q(sqrt 2) it is G_Q(zeta_8): the model with all CM endomorphisms K-rational fails over totally real K

tests.name: T inside K'

tests.name: characteristic p

gaps.title: Breuil-Diamond weight-two lifting theorem over totally real fields
gaps.detail: For F totally real, l odd and r : G_F -> GL2(Qbar_l) continuous, finitely ramified, det r = eps^-1 psi with psi of finite order, potentially semistable with labelled weights {0,1} at every v | l: if r-bar is residually modular and absolutely irreducible on G_(F(zeta_l)), and when l = 5 either (a) the image of r-bar(G_(F(zeta_5))) in PGL2(Fbar_5) is not isomorphic to PSL2(F5) or (b) r-bar is the scalar extension of r0 : G_F -> GL2(F5) with det r0 = eps-bar_5^-1, then r is modular, with no matching of local types. For l != 5 and for (a): BD14 Theoreme 3.2.2 (hypotheses lines 2144-2146), from Gee's prescribed-type lifts, BLGG12 Theorems 6.1.5 and 6.1.8, BLGG13II Theorems 2.1.2 and 3.1.2, Kisin09 (3.5.5). For (b): FLHS15 Section 2, whose argument uses the F5-model (PGL2(F5) -> F5^x/(F5^x)^2 is det r0 mod squares); without an F5-model the determinant does not control the projective square class. GL2ModularityLifting §§5.7 and 5.10 need potentially Barsotti-Tate representations, matched ordinary components and residue field F_p.
gaps.needs: The universal modularity conclusion of Breuil-Diamond Theoreme 3.2.2 for weight-two potentially semistable lifts over totally real fields, without local matching or residue-field restriction, with its five-adic projective-image hypothesis replaced, for residual representations having an F5-model with determinant eps-bar_5^-1, by the Freitas-Le Hung-Siksek argument.

gaps.title: Solvable residual modularity in cohomological weight over totally real fields
gaps.detail: For F totally real, p odd and r-bar : G_F -> GL2(Fbar_p) continuous, absolutely irreducible, totally odd with solvable image, r-bar is the semisimplified reduction of rho_(pi0,iota) for a cuspidal pi0 of cohomological type (all k_tau >= 2). R17.5.14 gives only a parallel-weight-one witness. Route: Langlands-Tunnell weight one over F; a finite soluble totally real extension F'/F, linearly disjoint from the field of r-bar, over which r-bar is unramified at every place above p (F'/F is in general ramified above p: an unramified extension leaves residual inertia, e.g. diag(-1,1), unchanged, a ramified quadratic one kills it); Hida theory to an ordinary parallel-weight-two form over F' as in the proof of BLGG13II Theorem 3.1.1, p.3 (lines 129-145), which treats p = 3 under its own hypotheses. The arbitrary-p statement and the return from F' to F are the supplier's obligation; elliptic case FLHS15 Theorem 6.
gaps.needs: Residual modularity in a cohomological weight for every totally odd absolutely irreducible solvable mod-p representation of a totally real field, p odd.

gaps.title: Field of definition of the endomorphisms of a CM elliptic curve
gaps.detail: For K of characteristic zero, Kbar an algebraic closure, G_K = Gal(Kbar/K), and E/K elliptic with End(E_Kbar) an order in an imaginary quadratic field: for a nonzero invariant differential omega over K, [.] : End(E_Kbar) -> Kbar, alpha^* omega = [alpha] omega, is an injective ring homomorphism independent of omega with [g alpha g^-1] = g([alpha]) for g in G_K; with T the quadratic field generated by its image, alpha is defined over K <= K' <= Kbar exactly when [alpha] is in K', so the kernel of G_K on End(E_Kbar) is G_KT. Route: additivity and contravariance of differential pullback (EllipticCurves Layer 1; Tau Ceti TauCeti.Isogeny.Hom.pullbackDifferential, pullbackDifferential_comp, pullbackDifferential_add_invariantDifferential), separability of nonzero isogenies in characteristic zero, K-rationality of omega, descent of morphisms (EllipticCurves Layer 0.5); OpenAI26 Section 9.4, p.27 (lines 1200-1202). Gal(KT/K) has order at most 2, so g([alpha]) = g^-1([alpha]). Characteristic zero is needed: Frobenius over a finite field pulls omega back to 0. The case j = 0 over a field containing zeta_3 is a special case. The criterion over a number field K that all endomorphisms are K-rational exactly when T lies in K is its specialization.
gaps.needs: For every field K of characteristic zero and every elliptic E/K with geometric CM, the differential embedding of End(E_Kbar) into Kbar is Galois equivariant, so an endomorphism is defined over K' exactly when its differential scalar lies in K' and the kernel of G_K on End(E_Kbar) is G_KT.
